summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the 3 follow-up features (Export/Import JSON backup, student lesson progress tracking, admin Announcements board) plus regression of existing flows on the public preview URL (HashRouter, localStorage store). All requested scenarios passed. Verified: default seeded announcement rendering + dismiss persistence, overall/module progress counters and real-time toggle, admin announcement CRUD with tone + validation toast, cross-role visibility, export download (file content asserted), import restore (valid + invalid file), reset confirm dialog dismissal, protected routes, YouTube iframe, live page, WhatsApp button.

issues: When the currently active lesson is also completed, the title shows emerald 'active' styling and no strike-through (active class wins over done); the green checkmark on the thumbnail still renders. Cosmetic only - verified strike-through + checkmark appear correctly for completed non-active lessons.

action_items: Optional: scope dismissed announcements per user (currently global key 'ta_dismissed_ann'), so a dismissal by one student does not hide the banner for another student on the same browser; also prune ids of deleted announcements.
Optional: resetAll() does not clear 'ta_dismissed_ann' - after a reset the re-seeded default announcement 'ann-1' stays hidden if it was previously dismissed.
Optional refactor: /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx is 793 lines (>700) - split AnnouncementsTab/DataTab/etc. into separate files.
Note (by design of static app): exported backup JSON contains admin + student passwords in plaintext; consider a warning in the UI copy.
critical_code_review_comments: DataTab.handleExport revokes the object URL immediately after a.click() and never appends the anchor to the DOM - works in Chromium (verified real download 'trading-academy-backup-2026-08-16.json' with valid JSON) but is fragile in Firefox/Safari; append+revoke on timeout is safer.
importAll() only shallow-validates keys; a structurally wrong but JSON-valid file would be written to localStorage without schema checks (invalid non-JSON correctly toasts an error).

success_rate.backend: N/A (static app, no backend by design)

seed_data_creation: Test-only localStorage data (announcement 'TEST_ Market Holiday', imported backup /tmp/ta_backup_test.json with TEST_imported student/module). All data is browser-local; no persistent server state.
test_credentials: student/student123, admin/admin123 (from config.js DEFAULT_*; /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty - consider documenting there)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login inputs use testids login-username-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button with portal-switch-student|admin toggles (NOT student-username-input). Clear localStorage then reload before each scenario to re-seed. Progress key ta_progress_<username>, announcements key ta_announcements, dismissals key ta_dismissed_ann. Default seed = 3 modules / 4 lessons. Reset button triggers window.confirm - register a dialog handler that dismisses.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found; the only observations are per-browser (not per-user) dismissal scoping and active-vs-completed styling precedence in Modules.jsx line 304.
